name: code_graph
description: Sovereign Token-Budgeted Code Graph & Repository Map engine. Analyzes project structure, AST symbols, PageRank hierarchy, and blast radius within strict token ceiling.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'map' (token-budgeted ranked repo map), 'query' (find symbols/definitions), 'impact' (blast radius / dependents), 'overview' (fast architecture tree)

target_dir.description: Target root directory to analyze (defaults to workspace root)

max_tokens.description: Strict token ceiling budget (default: 1024). Output is strictly bounded: actual <= max_tokens.

focus_files.description: List of priority file paths to anchor PageRank importance scoring.

query.description: Symbol, identifier, or keyword to search when action is 'query' or 'impact'

detail_level.description: Level of detail: 'outline' (symbols only), 'compact' (files + key symbols), 'full' (all exports & calls)

keywords.description: Mandatory on the first tool call of a turn: Comma-separated technical domain keywords in English.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs.
